title: FSSAI Proposes New Classification Limits for High-Fat, Sugar & Salt (HFSS) Foods in Schools
summary: FSSAI proposed HFSS thresholds for school foods: Solid (>4.2g fat, >3g sugar, >0.625g salt per 100g); Liquid (>1.5g fat, >2g sugar, >0.175g salt per 100ml).
